Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts

Class Casts

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts.Casts
public final class Casts extends Object
Factory for the built-in casts.

of(String) takes a Laravel-style cast string and checks it only when the model first resolves its casts; the typed factories check their arguments at once. Cast strings are listed on of(String).

  • Method Details

    • of

      public static Cast<?> of(String spec)
      Returns a cast for a Laravel-style cast string, parsed later.

      Accepted types, matched after trimming and lower-casing the part before the first :: int, integer, real, float, double, string, bool, boolean, decimal:N (N 0 to 30), decimal:P,S, decimal:P,S,MODE (a RoundingMode name, any case), date, date:F, immutable_date[:F], datetime, datetime:F, immutable_datetime[:F], custom_datetime:F, timestamp, json, array, json:unicode, instant. The argument is kept as written. A format F is a DateTimeFormatter pattern; a PHP format such as Y-m-d compiles with a different meaning.

      Parameters:
      spec - the cast string
      Returns:
      a placeholder the model resolves when it first reads its casts
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if spec is null

    • decimal

      public static Cast<Object> decimal(int precision, int scale)
      Returns the strict decimal:P,S cast, which refuses a value that does not fit.

      Precision is the total digits and scale the digits after the point, as in Blueprint.decimal. A value with more decimals than the scale, or more than precision minus scale integer digits, throws InvalidCastException; the message never carries the value.

      Parameters:
      precision - the total number of digits, 1 to 1000
      scale - the digits after the point, 0 to the precision and at most 30
      Returns:
      a cast reading BigDecimal at the given scale
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if precision or scale is out of range

    • decimal

      public static Cast<Object> decimal(int precision, int scale, RoundingMode mode)
      Returns the strict decimal:P,S,MODE cast, which rounds extra decimals with a mode.

      Integer digits beyond precision minus scale are refused whatever the mode, also when rounding carries into a new digit.

      Parameters:
      precision - the total number of digits, 1 to 1000
      scale - the digits after the point, 0 to the precision and at most 30
      mode - how extra decimals are rounded; UNNECESSARY refuses them
      Returns:
      a cast reading BigDecimal at the given scale
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if precision or scale is out of range, or mode is null

    • decimalText

      public static Cast<Object> decimalText(int precision, int scale)
      Returns the strict decimal cast for a text column, which keeps every digit on every database.

      The precision and scale rules are those of decimal(int, int). The 15-digit limit that decimal(p, s) applies on SQLite is skipped, because a text column stores the digits as written; use it for long exact values, such as exchange rates, on a string column. SQL sorts, compares and sums such a column as text, so do that math in Java.

      Parameters:
      precision - the total number of digits, 1 to 1000
      scale - the digits after the point, 0 to the precision and at most 30
      Returns:
      a cast reading BigDecimal at the given scale
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if precision or scale is out of range

    • instant

      public static Cast<Object> instant()
      Returns the instant cast, which stores an Instant whatever the model's TimestampFormat.

      Reads as an Instant from any stored form. Writes truncate to microseconds and accept the same values as datetime(). A bare number is refused. Use it for Blueprint.instant columns other than created_at, updated_at and deleted_at; those columns are also written by the framework in the model's format, so they need TimestampFormat.INSTANT on the model and a cast of this kind fails fast on a text-format model.

      Returns:
      a cast reading and writing Instant

    • typeName

      public static String typeName(Cast<?> cast)
      Returns the canonical type name of a cast, used by hasCast.

      Built-ins return one name per family whatever alias or argument was used: int, float, string, bool, decimal, date, datetime, timestamp, instant, json, enum. Any other cast returns its class name. A cast string is parsed first.

      Parameters:
      cast - the cast
      Returns:
      the type name
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if cast is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if cast is an invalid cast string

    • resolve

      public static Cast<?> resolve(Cast<?> cast)
      Turns a cast string from of(String) into its built-in cast; returns any other cast unchanged.

      Internal to the model layer, which calls it once per model class and wraps a failure in an InvalidCastException naming the model and key. Application code does not need it.

      Parameters:
      cast - the cast
      Returns:
      the resolved cast
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if cast is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if cast is an invalid cast string
